entities.summary: Kurt Sucksdorff was a Swedish ice hockey goaltender who won a silver medal at the 1928 Winter Olympics. He was a backup for Nils Johansson and therefore played only two matches. At the 1931 World Championships he played all six matches and achieved a scoreless draw against Canada, yet his team placed sixth.
